provenance.clustering_note: The 180 samples are 36 questions x 5 seeds, so they are clustered rather than independent; the effective sample size is nearer 36 than 180. No standard error is quoted on these coefficients for that reason.
provenance.fit_method: unregularized maximum-likelihood 1-D logistic regression, Newton-Raphson/IRLS on numpy (llm/experiment1/fit_calibration.py:fit_logistic)

diagnostics.note: auc_fitted_probability is a RECOVERY check, not held-out evidence: the sigmoid is monotone, so it must reproduce the raw signal's ranking exactly. Generalization evidence is E1's own five-seed result (e1_signal_mean_auc above).
